non_room_circulation_rule: Undercroft, service corridors, screens passage, landings, and service passages are movement spaces, not solution Room cards.

protected_locked_zones.rule: Every ordinary door, internal threshold, or secret passage entering a guest quarter or alchemist area begins locked. Map DCs are preserved and raised to the protected minimum where necessary.
protected_locked_zones.trap_rule: Existing authored trapped entries remain trapped. At match setup, difficulty may add Trap-deck cards to additional protected-zone entries marked eligible.

opening_victim_start_override.rule: The opening victim does not remain at the normal starter cell. Their body is placed on a legal body cell inside the selected murder room, and their ghost spawns at that body.
opening_victim_start_override.work_together: All other living characters retain their assigned two-row Foyer positions.
opening_victim_start_override.free_for_all: All other living characters retain their distributed four-floor starter positions.
